requirement: Update an antibiotic: the target antibiotic and the requested antibiotic group must both exist and must not be soft-deleted, then map the new name, group, and classification onto the tracked entity, save it, and report Updated.

preconditions.text: A live antibiotic exists for the target ID
A live antibiotic group exists for the requested group ID
The requested group ID matches no live group
The target ID matches no live antibiotic

inputs.text: Rename Amoxicillin to 'Co-amoxiclav' with classification AccessWatch
Rename Amoxicillin to 'Piperacillin-tazobactam' with classification Watch
Move Azithromycin from Beta-lactams to the existing Macrolides group
Update request with an unknown antibiotic ID
Update request with an unknown group ID
Update request with a soft-deleted group ID

returns.text: Success with Updated status; name, group, and classification are persisted
UpdatedAt is refreshed on every successful update
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Antibiotic group ID not exists' error; target untouched
Failure with BadRequest and the 'Antibiotic not found' error

exception_text: No unhandled exception; every rejection is returned as a failed Result
